beats.say: Storage full is a message nobody wants, usually right before a photo.
First, look at what is using the space. Your settings show it, app by app.
Big videos and old chat downloads are usually the heavy ones.
Back up your photos to the cloud, check they are there, and only then delete them from the phone.
Clear app caches and remove apps you have not opened in months.
Do this today, and share it with someone whose phone is always full.
